title: The Emerald Stretch
subtitle: Eighty emerald cuts, matched and set edge to edge, moving on the Flex.

stone.origin: Natural. 80 matched emerald-cut diamonds, 0.375 ct each, set edge-to-edge.

description: Eighty matched emerald-cut diamonds set edge to edge along the patented Bez Ambar Flex, so a long run of step-cut light moves as one with the wrist. The emerald cut returns light in wide, calm planes rather than scattered fire; repeated eighty times in a continuous line, that calm becomes a single sheet of brilliance across the wrist. The Flex carries it without hinge or clasp, pouring around the arm and shifting as the hand does. Made in eighteen-karat gold or platinum.
